name: Wick the Guide
voice: Cheerful, quick, always half a step ahead of you and pointing. Calls everyone 'friend'. Never says 'I don't know'; says 'ah, that way' and means whichever way amuses him.
agenda: Lead them wrong for the joy of it. Send whoever asks the long way round, and send rivals toward each other. Tell the truth about the well: the winch pays two who pull together, and he wants to see it pulled.
knows: The Marrow Reliquary lies on the altar in the Reliquary, past the Ossuary Gate, and nothing guards it.
The Bone Well's cache holds a Veteran Blade, at the bottom step, and the well is a dead end.
The Cellar Drowner keeps the Drowned Cellar's cache; nobody searches there while it lives.
The Lantern Walk joins the Bell Tower to the Drowned Cellar under the stair.
